text: Heineken N.V. is listed on Euronext Amsterdam. Its corporate governance statement (Annual Report 2023) lists one substantial shareholding notified to the Dutch financial markets authority: Mrs. C.L. de Carvalho-Heineken holds indirectly 50.005% of its issued share capital, through the direct 50.005% shareholder Heineken Holding N.V.
short: Heineken N.V. is 50.005% held by Heineken Holding N.V., indirectly Mrs. C.L. de Carvalho-Heineken's.

source.name: Heineken N.V.: Corporate Governance statement (Annual Report 2023)
source.quote: Mrs. C.L. de Carvalho-Heineken (holds indirectly 50.005% of the issued share capital of the Company; the direct 50.005% shareholder is Heineken Holding N.V.)
source.note: Same statement: 'Its shares are listed on the Amsterdam Stock Exchange, Euronext Amsterdam.' It also says FEMSA sold its shares in the Company and Heineken Holding N.V. in February and May 2023.
